profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER (AWS CERTIFIED SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT)
			Full Stack Engineering | Software Design | Engineering Support 
                                               (470) 258-6082 / nhchanh@gmail.com 															

Analytical and results-driven professional with over 15 years of experience architecting and delivering high-performance, scalable applications and cloud-based systems. Expert in leveraging AI-assisted development tools, including GitHub Copilot, to enhance coding efficiency and accelerate delivery of robust solutions. Proficient in designing modular, user-centric systems, as demonstrated through end-to-end design of scalable e-commerce platform. Skilled in full-stack development, cloud architecture, and agile methodologies, with proven ability to collaborating effectively with diverse teams to align technical solutions with business objectives. Possess advanced proficiency in cloud-native development and DevOps practices. Committed to driving innovation, mentoring teams, and delivering cutting-edge solutions.

Technical Skills	
	- Full-Stack Development: Java 17/24, Spring Boot, ReactJS, Redux, NodeJS, HTML5, CSS Bootstrap  
	- Cloud & DevOps: AWS (VPC, EC2, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB), Kubernetes, Gradle, Jenkins, Artifactory  
	- Database Management: PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Flyway, Liquibase  
	- Testing & Quality Assurance: TDD, BDD, Cucumber, TestNG, Mockito, Selenium, Testcontainers  
	- Software Architecture: Domain-Driven Design (DDD), API-First Development, Microservices, Clean Architecture  
	- Collaboration & Leadership: Cross-functional team coordination, mentoring, agile methodologies

Personal Project
GitHub: https://github.com/nhchanh/the-hobbit-store 
Designed and implemented POC of a scalable e-commerce platform using Java 24, Spring Boot, and Domain-Driven Design principles, with 70% of coding assisted by AI, primarily through GitHub Copilot, to enhance productivity and code quality. Architected microservices for product, inventory, cart, and review management, ensuring maintainability.  
	- Developed RESTful APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger for seamless integration and comprehensive documentation.  
	- Implemented automated testing at unit, integration, and end-to-end levels using TestNG, Mockito, and Karate.  
	- Integrated Next.js for modern frontend development, supporting multi-device and multi-environment deployments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: North Atlanta, Georgia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Orchestrate the development and maintenance of Event Registration Management modules, including JUnit, Karate, and Cucumber tests, with focus on scalable microservices and seamless legacy system migrations. Implemented automated testing at unit, integration, and end-to-end levels using JUnit, Mockito, and Karate to ensure comprehensive coverage and system reliability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement solutions that enhance system performance and user experience. Leverage Java 17, Dropwizard and Spring Boot, ReactJS, and AWS services to deliver cloud-native applications. Ensure data integrity and system reliability through advanced database management and automated testing strategies.
	▪ Spearheaded research, design, and initial planning for migrating legacy SOAP-based meeting request management components to microservices, ensuring seamless integration.  
	▪ Engineered data transformation processes to convert legacy data into microservice-compatible formats, implementing data consistency checkers to validate migrations.  
	▪ Developed and maintained critical event management modules using ReactJS, Redux, NodeJS, and PostgreSQL, optimizing for performance and scalability.
	▪ Enhanced performance of the reports module by tuning MS SQL queries and optimizing stored procedures.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and maintained core business logic for data extraction and processing, supporting key performance indicator (KPI) generation and source measure creation for external clients. Enhanced system functionality through advanced data warehousing and UI improvements, utilizing Java, Spring Boot, and SQL Server. Coordinated with internal and external stakeholders to deliver multiple releases of Impact 360’s Performance Management and eLearning modules, ensuring high-quality standards.     
	▪  Developed and maintained core business logic for data extraction and loading from multiple sources using T-SQL, Spring Boot, Spring Core, Enterprise Java Bean (EJB), Java, Apache Commons Collection/Lang, and TestNG, enhancing system efficiency.
	▪  Streamlined Source Measures and KPI creation for external clients by leveraging Spring Boot, Spring Core, EJB, Java, Apache Commons Collection/Lang, and TestNG, reducing process complexity and improving client reporting accuracy.
	▪  Enhanced Calculator Engine for Impact 360 Scorecards (versions 15.1.0 and 15.2.0) using data warehousing, SQL Server stored procedures, EJB, Java, and TestNG, optimizing data processing performance and scalability.
	▪  Upgraded Online Learning module (versions 15.1.0 and 15.2.0) using SQL Server, EJB, Java, JSP, AICC, SCORM2004, and TestNG, improving functionality and user experience for eLearning platforms.
	▪  Resolved customer issues through testing and troubleshooting, utilizing Spring Framework, Spring Boot, EJB, JSP, ExtJS, React JS, Redux, CSS, TestNG, Mockito, Cucumber, Gradle, Jenkins, Artifactory, Selenium, and TDD, ensuring high-quality deliverables.
	▪  Coordinated cross-functional teams to deliver multiple releases of Impact 360’s Performance Management, Coaching Management, eLearning, and Content Producer modules on schedule, maintaining top-tier quality standards.
	▪  Optimized PostgreSQL database schemas for multi-tenancy and high performance.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the architectural design and development of zillable.com, delivering a high-quality prototype and beta version using AWS, MongoDB, and Spring frameworks. Directed project planning and managed offshore teams to maximize collaboration and innovation. Designed scalable cloud infrastructure leveraging AWS services, ensuring robust performance and reliability.       
	▪ Architected technical infrastructure using AWS (VPC, EC2, S3, Route 53), enabling scalable and secure application deployment.  
	▪ Developed high-fidelity prototype using Spring REST, AngularJS, and MongoDB, accelerating product development and stakeholder buy-in.  
	▪ Promoted open collaboration within offshore teams, driving innovation and effective product development.
